5052532142487.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Shatter Resistant Design
The ornaments use a shatter resistant construction for the stated decorative use. They provide an alternative to traditional glass decorations when arranging the display, while retaining a defined shape and finish for the festive setting.

Glitter Finish
The glitter finish adds a light catching detail to the surface. It brings a more textured appearance to the decorative arrangement and pairs well with plain finishes when you want the smaller design elements to remain visible.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and White. Quantity: 24 pack.
Shatter resistant plastic construction provides a safe, durable alternative to traditional glass ornaments for festive decorating.
Eye-catching glitter finish adds textured sparkle and light-reflecting detail to enhance your Christmas tree display.
Lightweight and compact design allows for easy handling, storage, and convenient placement among tree branches.
Reusable quality ensures long-term value; simply clean and store between seasons for continued festive enjoyment.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering
Included: 24 Christmas Baubles
Hanger included

Product Brief

 This crystal cascade snowflake hanging light is a gorgeous Christmas hanging ornament powered by battery box. 
 It features a large icy‑blue illuminated snowflake as the top topper, matched with realistic pine sprigs and bright red berry accents. 
 Multiple layered hanging strands dangle down, decorated with glowing small snowflake ornaments and faceted teardrop crystal drops. 
 Mixed warm‑white and cool‑blue LED lights twinkle through transparent pendants, delivering dreamy sparkling light refraction. 
 Powered by battery box, no plug‑in required, easy to hang for winter and Christmas festive atmosphere.

Product Specifications

 Product Name: Crystal Cascade Snowflake Hanging Light
 Dimension: 25×25×55 cm (9.84×9.84×21.65 inch)
 Light Source: Mixed warm‑white & icy‑blue LED
 Power Supply: Battery box operated (batteries not included)
 Material: Acrylic snowflake & crystal drops, artificial pine leaves, red berries, plastic & wire frame
 Package: 1 piece per unit

Application Scenarios

 Covered outdoor: Porch eaves, patio, hanging on snow‑covered tree branches, front entryway, gazebo
 Indoor: Hallway, stairwell, entrance hall, ceiling, window display, living‑room Christmas decoration
 Commercial scenes: Shop window, café, restaurant, mall seasonal display
 Christmas party, winter theme event, holiday gift

Notes

 Operated by battery box, batteries are NOT included in package. Please prepare compatible batteries by yourself.
 For covered‑outdoor use only. Keep the battery box dry and well‑protected against rain, snow and splashing water. Do not expose battery box directly to moisture.
 Hang on stable load‑bearing positions. Do not hang on fragile thin supports.
【CASCADING CHRISTMAS LIGHT DESIGN】Decorative holiday toppers combine with cascading LED strands, illuminated snowflake accents, and clear crystal-style drops to create a layered hanging display with strong festive visual impact.
【BRIGHT FESTIVE LED GLOW】LED lights illuminate the cascading strands and reflective crystal-style details, creating a warm, sparkling effect that becomes especially eye-catching in evening and nighttime Christmas displays.
【SNOWFLAKE & CRYSTAL DETAILS】Faceted clear drops, hanging bead-style strands, and glowing snowflake elements add depth, texture, and movement beneath the topper, giving the decoration a distinctive winter-inspired look.
【HANGING PORCH DECOR, NO FLOOR SPACE NEEDED】The vertical suspended design adds Christmas decoration without taking up lawn, table, or floor space. Suitable for covered porches, entryways, patios, windows, and indoor holiday display areas.
【6 FESTIVE STYLES TO CHOOSE FROM】Available in 6 Christmas-inspired designs for different seasonal decorating themes. Great for home decorating, holiday parties, family gatherings, entry displays, and Christmas photo settings.

8941467526387.baseName: Christmas Mini Cabinet Wreaths 6 Pack Norfolk Pine Ribbon Bows Red Berries Pinecones Artificial Kitchen Door Wall Decor
8941467526387.variantName: Christmas Mini Cabinet Wreaths 6 Pack Norfolk Pine Ribbon Bows Red Berries Pinecones Artificial Kitchen Door Wall Decor
8941467526387.sourceDescription:
Six mini cabinet wreaths in Norfolk pine style, each built on an artificial pine base and finished with a red velvet ribbon bow, clusters of small red berries and pinecones. The sprigs are spaced evenly around the ring so the wreath looks full from the front, with the berries sitting proud of the foliage, and the plastic foliage and velvet bows keep their shape and colour year after year with no watering and no need for daylight.

Each wreath is 11 in across once fluffed out, and measures 26 in from the top of the velvet hanging string to the bottom of the wreath. The wreaths travel in a compact box to keep the parcel small, so the bows arrive creased. Unfold them and tease the branches into shape and the full 11 in diameter comes back; the plastic branches spring out rather than dropping needles, and the wreath then holds its form.

Hanging takes seconds. Tape or pin the top of the red velvet string behind a cabinet door, then let the wreath sit flat against the panel. The same method works on a window, a wall, a chair back, a front door, a fireplace or a porch pillar, where a small hook or nail will do. The berries and pinecones are fixed firmly and will not drop off with handling.

Suitable for indoor use, and for outdoor use under cover away from rain and snow. Six wreaths dress a whole run of kitchen cabinets at once, or one window and door each. Colour: green and red. Supplied as six wreaths.

8941467469387.sourceDescription:
Fifteen little Scandinavian gnomes, all different — different hat patterns, different trims, different colours — which means a tree dressed with them looks thoughtfully put together rather than bought in bulk. Each is about fifteen centimetres tall.

They're made from soft felt and fibre wool with knitted hats, so they're pleasant to handle rather than scratchy, and nothing is glued on loosely enough to fall off in the box. A red string on top of each means they hang anywhere in moments.

Scandinavian tomte are traditionally the ones who guard the house at Christmas, which is a nicer story than most decorations have. Hang them on the tree, stand them on a shelf, or line them along the mantelpiece.

5056747873587.sourceDescription:
These holiday gnome crafts suit any setting. Hang them on branches, wreaths, garlands, or stair rails. They also double as unique gift tags, party décor accents, or charming tabletop decorations for seasonal events.
Charming Scandinavian Gnome Hanging Pendants: This delightful set features four handcrafted wooden gnome pendants, each dressed in festive red and green attire with hand-painted beards, hats, and printed snowflake motifs. Made from nature-friendly MDF, they bring a cosy, playful-inspired touch to your holiday décor.
Exquisite Craftmanship & Durable Material: Each pendant is carefully carved from composite MDF wood for an authentic look and lasting quality. The lightweight construction ensures they hang straight, while sealed edges protect against wear and moisture—ready to grace your tree year after year.
Versatile Display Options: Suspended by natural jute twine threaded through a white wooden bead, these rustic ornaments suit any setting. Hang them on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, stair railings, or fireplaces—or use them as unique gift tags and tabletop accents.
Perfect for Every Occansion: Ideal for themed holiday parties, family celebrations, weddings, baby showers, and festive dinners, these wooden gnome decorations infuse cheer and a sense of good luck into any event—making them a versatile addition to your seasonal collection.
Four Playful Designs: The set includes - Gnome holding a wrapped gift (8.2 cm × 12.5 cm), Gnome clutching a miniature fir tree (6.4 cm × 12.5 cm), Gnome presenting a snowflake star (6.2 cm × 11.7 cm), Gnome with candy-cane staff (6.2 cm × 12.4 cm) – all can be suspended by the given natural jute twine threaded through a white wooden bead.

5090061356487.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

5096042276287.baseName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath with 20 battery-operated lights and red accents for a hallway or mantelpiece - 30 cm
5096042276287.variantName: LED Christmas wreath - Light-up door wreath with 20 battery-operated lights and red accents for a hallway or mantelpiece - 30 cm
5096042276287.sourceDescription:
Twenty LEDs illuminate the red accents on this compact 30 cm Christmas decoration. The battery box takes two AA batteries, sold separately, making it easy to plan a display on a door or wall away from a socket.

The lighting gives this wreath two different uses in the same spot. In natural daylight the decorative details provide the colour and texture. Once the lights are switched on, the outline is still visible from the far end of a hall. Allow access to the battery compartment when arranging the display. Positioning it where you can change the cells without disturbing the front of the decoration makes a difference if you leave it up throughout the season.

View the arrangement in daylight first, then turn on the lights with the room lighting lowered. The two views can look quite different, and a small change in position often makes the points of light easier to see. To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree. Even a single matching accent can bring two separate displays together.

A plain background lets you see the smaller details even from the other side of the room. Try holding the wreath against a light wall and then against a darker door before fixing the hanging point. When dressing an entrance, allow for the full movement of the door as well as the width of the decoration. Set it clear of the handle, letter plate and frame so the arrangement stays in position as people come and go.

After the festive season, lay the decoration in a box with space around its edges.

When packing away a lit decoration, support the body of the wreath and give the lighting components their own space. Store the controls alongside it so that they are easy to locate when the decorations come out again.
Compact 30 cm design ideal for hallways, mantelpieces, or small door displays.
Features 20 battery-operated LEDs illuminating red accents for festive lighting.
Versatile decoration suitable for both natural daylight and illuminated evening views.
Easy to position away from sockets using two AA batteries (sold separately).
Comes with Wreath with integrated LED lights
Batteries sold separately

5061030167687.sourceDescription:
Capture the beauty of a snowy winter’s day with The Christmas Centre Jack Frost 6ft (180cm) Pre-Lit Christmas Garland, a stunning decoration that brings crisp seasonal charm into your home. At 180cm in length, this garland is crafted with lush, full foliage that has been delicately frosted to create the appearance of freshly fallen snow, giving it a sparkling, icy look that perfectly complements both traditional and contemporary festive styles. Its wintry finish makes it a striking choice for staircases, mantelpieces, doorways, or festive table centrepieces.

To enhance its frosted beauty, the garland is illuminated by 100 warm white LED lights, carefully woven through the branches to cast a soft, welcoming glow. Battery powered with 6x AA batteries, it offers complete flexibility in placement without the need for nearby sockets or unsightly cables. With eight different lighting functions to choose from, you can create the perfect atmosphere, whether you prefer a gentle, steady shine or a playful twinkle to brighten your celebrations.

Suitable for indoor use or covered outdoor spaces, the Jack Frost Garland is a versatile decoration designed to adapt beautifully to any setting. It looks equally stunning as a standalone piece or as part of a coordinated display with the matching Jack Frost Wreath, creating a cohesive festive theme throughout your home.

The Christmas Centre Jack Frost Pre-Lit Garland combines the timeless appeal of frosted greenery with the convenience of modern LED lighting. Designed to be enjoyed year after year, it’s a decoration that will fill your home with wintry elegance, festive sparkle, and seasonal warmth.
6ft (180cm) long
Battery Operated
8 Functions including static
Indoor use or outdoor under cover
100 warm white LED lights
No. of tips: 260
6 x AA batteries (not included)
Extras: Flocked with berries and antlers

Bring festive charm to your home with this set of 5 acrylic robin Christmas lights, featuring 40 bright white LEDs for a beautiful seasonal glow. Each robin contains 8 LEDs that shine through the clear acrylic body, creating a delightful illuminated display for mantelpieces, windowsills, Christmas trees and garden walls.
Suitable for indoor and outdoor use, these battery-powered LED robin lights feature durable, weather-resistant acrylic and an IP44-rated battery pack. The 50cm clear lead cable lets you discreetly position the battery pack behind decorations or foliage, without needing a nearby plug socket. Simply insert 3 x AA batteries, not included.
The built-in timer switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, automatically repeating the cycle each day. Manual on/off control is also available. Each robin measures 13.8 x 11 x 7cm, with 30cm cable spacing between birds, giving you flexibility to arrange them in a row or group them within a festive display.
SET OF 5 ACRYLIC ROBIN LIGHTS: Create a charming Christmas display with five decorative robins, each measuring 13.8 x 11 x 7cm. Ideal for mantelpieces, windowsills, shelves, Christmas trees and garden walls.

BATTERY POWERED FOR FLEXIBLE PLACEMENT: Display your robin Christmas lights without a nearby plug socket. Includes an IP44-rated battery pack and a discreet 50cm clear lead cable. Requires 3 x AA batteries, not included.
AUTOMATIC 6-HOUR TIMER: Enjoy festive lighting every day with a built-in 6-hour on / 18-hour off timer that repeats automatically. Manual on/off control lets you operate the lights whenever you choose.
WEATHER-RESISTANT WITH 30CM SPACING: Durable acrylic robins are suitable for indoor and outdoor displays. The 30cm cable between each bird provides 120cm of connecting cable from the first robin to the last for flexible arrangements.

Plan the display

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

5059442204687.variantName: Nordmann Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant - 4ft (120cm) · 本规格 / Selected: 4ft
5059442204687.sourceDescription:
Nordmann Fir is a hugely popular Christmas tree due to its rich green foliage, soft needles, and naturally well-balanced shape. The broad, sturdy branches provide plenty of room for decorations, while the foliage has excellent needle retention, helping the tree stay looking fresh throughout the Christmas period. The needles are also less prickly than many other conifers, making decorating easy and safe for little hands without the risk of being scratched.
A DISTINCTIVE NORDMANN FIR: The foliage has a rich green colour and a glossy appearance, while the needles are broad, soft, and blunt-tipped. This gives the Nordmann Fir its characteristic look and makes it a particularly popular variety for Christmas.
WHY CHOOSE POT-GROWN CHRISTMAS TREES?: This tree has been grown in its pot from the beginning, rather than being lifted from the ground and transferred into a container shortly before sale. Its roots have had time to develop within the pot as the tree has grown, without the disturbance of being dug up and moved. This makes it better suited to continuing its growth after Christmas, with a more established root system already growing in the pot. Unlike potted Christmas trees that have only recently been transferred from the ground, it can be kept outdoors and grown on after the festive season.
A REAL CHRISTMAS TREE THAT HOLDS ITS NEEDLES: Excellent needle retention helps the Nordmann Fir stay fresh-looking throughout the festive period, reducing the amount of fallen foliage as the weeks go by. Strong branches also provide good support for decorations.
GROW IT AS AN OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS TREE: After Christmas, move the tree back outside so it can continue growing in cooler conditions. As it develops, the evergreen foliage can also provide year-round interest among other evergreen trees for garden planting.
A POTTED REAL CHRISTMAS TREE FOR FLEXIBLE DISPLAY: Growing in a container means the Nordmann Fir can be moved to different positions as needed, making it easier to manage where the tree is placed. This also makes it possible to grow a Christmas tree without committing immediately to planting it permanently in the ground.
Please Note: Our pot grown trees are measured from the base of the pot to the tip of the tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
